Further to the left and upper-left (0.5 to 0.9 metres away) are several plastic bottles and a large red cylindrical container, while to the upper-right and right (0.5 to 0.8 metres away, separated from the rolling board by 0.15 to 0.3 metres) sit two round metal plates holding dough balls and rolled flatbreads. In the first three frames, the camera view remains steady while the wearer's left hand holds the rolling pin on the left of the board and the right hand lifts and turns the flat dough disc on the board, with the upper-right plates, left-side bottles, and top red container partially cropped by the frame edges. Across frames 4 and 5, the camera pitches slightly upward and turns counter-clockwise (shifting the view toward the upper-right), bringing the full red container on the left, both metal plates on the right, and small containers further ahead (up to 1.0 metre away) fully into view as the wearer's hands move from rolling the dough with both hands in frame 4 to resting the rolling pin on the board and touching the right-hand plate in frame 5.
